timeline.summary: Greven il-Vec rises through schemes and assassinations blessed by Volrath.
timeline.quote: Greven has attained his powerful rank through a series of underhanded schemes and assassinations

citation.text: Greven il-Vec (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew takes Karn, Tahngarth and the Legacy artifacts hostage while Gerrard is knocked overboard.
timeline.quote: When Weatherlight planeshifted to Rath, it was ambushed by the Predator

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Predator and Weatherlight duel as Weatherlight races to the portal Ertai holds open; Weatherlight escapes and both ships are heavily damaged.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight just managed to get to the portal and escape her pursuer, with both vessels sustaining major damage.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rathi rebels including Eladamri and Lin Sivvi attempt to sabotage the docked Predator but are foiled.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately, they were foiled

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Predator battles Weatherlight over Urborg; Ertai captures Gerrard and teleports him into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: managed to capture Gerrard and teleport him directly into the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth kills Greven and Predator is destroyed by being sent crashing into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Greven himself was killed by Tahngarth.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew take hostages.
timeline.quote: Predator' s crew took Karn , Tahngarth , and the Legacy artifacts hostage

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight and Predator duel again as Weatherlight races to the portal and escapes.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight just managed to get to the portal and escape her pursuer, with both vessels sustaining major damage.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn, frozen by conscience, does not resist as moggs carry him to the Predator.
timeline.quote: Karn did not resist as the moggs carried him to the *Predator*.

citation.text: Pacifism (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax watches Selenia lead the Predator to the Weatherlight and feels betrayed.
timeline.quote: Crovax had witnessed Selenia lead the *Predator* to the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Enfeeblement (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Predator lists the Weatherlight and Hanna screams.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* suddenly listed.

citation.text: Sudden Impact (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Ertai opens a portal with Lyna's help but is left behind as the Weatherlight flees Predator.
timeline.quote: the Weatherlight was being hotly pursued by Predator as it fled, and so was forced to leave Ertai behind.

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Journey to Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Predator ambushes Weatherlight and overpowers its crew.
timeline.quote: Predator caught it by surprise, boarded it, and soon overpowered its crew.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight smashes Predator into the Stronghold, then escapes through the Erratic Portal and Predator crashes into the rock face.
timeline.quote: Unable to stop in time, Predator smashed into the rock face, sustaining heavy damage.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Predator intercepts Weatherlight at Urborg; Greven's mind is dominated by Crovax and Tahngarth kills him.
timeline.quote: Greven soon fell beneath the raging minotaur

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and the Legacy treasury are taken, and Tahngarth jumps to save Karn but is overpowered and captured by Greven il-Vec.
timeline.quote: he was overpowered by Greven il -Vec and captured as well

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight hauls the Predator behind it.
timeline.quote: The *Weatherlight* dragged the *Predator* behind it

citation.text: Cataclysm (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Predator ambushes the Weatherlight under Greven's command.
timeline.quote: they were ambushed by the Predator , under the command of Greven il- Vec.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth stows away on the Predator.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth grabbed a rope and stowed away on the Predator as it flew away.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn surrenders to the Predator after accidentally killing a mogg.
timeline.quote: after surrendering to the Predator once he accidentally killed a mogg during the ambush

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Karn's Tale" ( J. Robert King )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna drags the Predator into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Hanna orders the steersman to speed up, dragging the Predator behind them and causing it to crash into the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Predator slams into the closing portal and Ertai falls at Greven's feet.
timeline.quote: the Predator slammed into it, causing Ertai to fall into the wreckage at the feet of the furious Greven il- Vec

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vhati watches a thunderhead from the Predator and sees Greven's mind in it.
timeline.quote: It is Greven's mind manifest.

citation.text: Rolling Thunder (Battle Royale Box Set, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Weatherlight escapes Rath, Ertai is captured aboard the Predator and Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril shapes him into Volrath's successor.
timeline.quote: Ertai is captured and held aboard the Predator

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay crashes the Predator into Crovax's stronghold.
timeline.quote: I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold.

citation.text: Hull Breach (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Predator attacks the Weatherlight; Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Sisay crashes the Predator into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth duels with Greven il -Vec and kills him

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven's Predator ambushes the Weatherlight and Greven battles Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Greven and his crew ambushed the Weatherlight, boarding the ship and engaging in a fierce personal battle with Gerrard.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tomalan severs the Predator's harpoon lines and is killed.
timeline.quote: Tomalan severed the harpoon lines before being shot and killed.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna drags the Predator into a collision with the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Hanna, acting quickly, managed to drag the Predator into a collision with the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Predator crashes into the portal, tumbling Ertai at Greven's feet, ending the assault.
timeline.quote: The Predator crashed into the portal, sending Ertai tumbling at Greven il-Vec

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight drags the Predator behind it.
timeline.quote: dragged the Predator behind it, the cradle hauling the casket.

citation.text: Cataclysm (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Frozen by conscience, Karn does not resist as the moggs carry him to the Predator.
timeline.quote: Frozen by conscience, Karn did not resist as the moggs carried him to the Predator.

citation.text: Pacifism (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Predator attacks the Weatherlight above the Plains of Rath and Greven il-Vec's forces board her to steal Gerrard's legacy.
timeline.quote: Volrath's forces, led by the fierce Greven il-Vec , board the Weatherlight in an attempt to steal Gerrard's mysterious legacy.

citation.text: "Gerrard's Quest", section "Volume 2: Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai agrees to open the portal with Lyna's help and is left behind as the Weatherlight flees.
timeline.quote: Ertai agreed, and they successfully opened the portal

citation.text: "Soltari", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
